name: redis_get
description: Get the value of a string key.

name: redis_set
description: Set the value of a string key.

name: redis_mget
description: Get multiple values in one round-trip. Keys are passed as a comma-separated string.

name: redis_hget
description: Get the value of a hash field.

name: redis_hset
description: Set the value of a hash field.

name: redis_hgetall
description: List all (field, value) pairs of a hash as a table.

name: redis_hscan
description: Cursor-paginated scan of a hash's fields.

name: redis_hscan_over_scan
description: For every key matching a SCAN pattern, run HSCAN and emit (key, field, value) rows. The high-throughput discovery primitive for migration / analysis.

name: redis_lpush
description: Push a value onto the head of a list.

name: redis_lrange
description: Get a range from a list as a comma-separated string.

name: redis_lrange_table
description: Get a range from a list as a table — one row per element. Easier to work with in SQL than the comma-separated form.

name: redis_del
description: Delete a key. Returns TRUE if the key existed and was removed.

name: redis_type
description: Get the Redis type of a key (string / list / hash / set / zset / stream / none).

name: redis_scan
description: Cursor-paginated SCAN of the keyspace. Returns 'cursor:keys_csv'. Iterate by re-passing the returned cursor.

name: redis_keys
description: List all keys matching a pattern as a table. Convenient but blocks the Redis server on large keyspaces — prefer redis_scan in production.
